uncalendared.silver_noaa_iod: the DMI series we serve is a NOAA record updated monthly IN PLACE (the ADR_IOD_SOURCE_SWITCH basis, CPC ERSSTv5) whose day-of-month habit no publisher page in this estate states; the first landing filed it under CPC's ENSO window, which is the ONI TABLE's clock and not the DMI's. BoM -- the publisher of the +/-0.4 degC convention and of the fortnightly Climate Driver Update, a DIFFERENT product from this series -- returned HTTP 403 on every path and both host forms in the design's delta pass (item B4.2) and is being renamed, so no rule can be read there either. The card's own '~30-45 days after month end' is a LAG, not a day habit: it lives in ym_publication_lag_days: 45, not here
